newsitem.title: ITALY: CIR share in Olivetti falls.
newsitem.headline: CIR share in Olivetti falls.

text.p: De Benedetti holding company CIR said on Thursday its stake in Italian information technology group Olivetti fell to 12.7 percent at the end of 1996 from above 14 percent previously.
A CIR spokeswoman confirmed the level of the stake and said notice had been sent to Italian stock market watchdog Consob.
CIR is the industrial holding of former Olivetti chairman Carlo De Benedetti, who resigned in September.
The company was due to hold a board meeting on Thursday although the spokeswoman said it was not expected to release preliminary 1996 results as Olivetti did on Wednesday.
At 1215 GMT CIR shares were trading 0.78 percent higher at 1,165 lire in a generally firmer market.

Monaco-based businessman Luigi Giribaldi has increased his stake gradually in CIR. In January he held around 12 percent of the company and has more than 20 percent of Cofide, the De Benedetti financial holding which controls it.
